info.title: Healthcare API
info.description:
A comprehensive API for managing patient, provider, appointment, diagnosis, prescription, and medical record data within a healthcare system. Adheres to HIPAA compliance requirements, ensuring secure and auditable access to Protected Health Information (PHI). All PHI access is logged for audit trails, and data is encrypted at rest and in transit. Access is controlled via OAuth 2.0 with role-based authorization.

**Service Level Agreements (SLAs):**
This API aims for 99.9% uptime. Typical response times are under 200ms for read operations and under 500ms for write operations. Individual endpoint timeouts are generally configured for 30 seconds. For critical operations, clients should implement appropriate retry mechanisms with exponential backoff.

get.description: Checks the health and availability of the API. Returns 200 OK if the service is running and able to connect to its dependencies.

503.description: Service Unavailable - API is not healthy or dependencies are down.

error.message: One or more critical dependencies are unavailable.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all patients. This endpoint is restricted and requires appropriate roles (e.g., 'admin', 'provider'). Patient data is sensitive and access is logged for HIPAA compliance.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set.

parameters.name: firstName
parameters.description: Filter patients by first name (case-insensitive, partial match).

parameters.name: lastName
parameters.description: Filter patients by last name (case-insensitive, partial match).

post.description: Registers a new patient in the system. Requires 'admin' or 'provider:write' role. All patient data is considered PHI and is handled with strict security measures.

get.summary: Get a patient record by ID
get.description: Retrieves a single patient's detailed record by their unique ID. Access is restricted to authorized roles (e.g., 'admin', 'provider', or the 'patient' themselves). All access is logged for HIPAA compliance.

parameters.name: patientId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the patient.

put.summary: Update a patient record by ID
put.description: Updates an existing patient's record. Requires 'admin' or 'provider:write' role. All updates are logged for HIPAA compliance.

parameters.name: patientId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the patient.

delete.summary: Delete a patient record by ID
delete.description: Deletes a patient record from the system. This operation is highly sensitive and typically restricted to 'admin' roles. Deletion is soft or requires specific data retention policies. All deletions are logged for HIPAA compliance.

parameters.name: patientId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the patient to be deleted.

get.summary: List appointments for a specific patient
get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of appointments associated with a given patient ID. Access is restricted to the patient themselves, their providers, or administrators. All access is logged for HIPAA compliance.

parameters.name: patientId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the patient.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set.

parameters.name: statusCode
parameters.description: Filter appointments by status code (e.g., 'scheduled', 'completed', 'cancelled').

200.description: A paginated list of patient appointments.

get.summary: List medical records for a specific patient
get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of medical records associated with a given patient ID. Access is highly restricted and logged for HIPAA compliance. Only authorized personnel (e.g., 'provider', 'admin') or the 'patient' themselves can access these records.

parameters.name: patientId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the patient.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set.

parameters.name: recordType
parameters.description: Filter medical records by type (e.g., 'lab_result', 'progress_note').

200.description: A paginated list of patient medical records.

medicalRecords.content: Blood test results: Hemoglobin 14.5 g/dL, White Blood Cell Count 7.2 K/uL.
Patient presented with mild fever and cough. Prescribed antibiotics.

post.summary: Grant patient consent for data sharing
post.description: Records a new consent from a patient for specific data sharing purposes. This is crucial for HIPAA compliance and patient autonomy. Requires 'patient:write' or 'admin:manage' role.

parameters.name: patientId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the patient.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all healthcare providers. Can be filtered by specialty. Requires 'patient:read', 'provider:read', or 'admin:manage' role.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set.

parameters.name: specialty
parameters.description: Filter providers by their medical specialty (e.g., 'Cardiology', 'Pediatrics').

post.description: Creates a new appointment for a patient with a provider. Requires 'patient:write' (for self-scheduling) or 'provider:write' / 'admin:manage' roles. All appointment details are logged.

get.description: Retrieves details of a specific appointment by its unique ID. Access is restricted to involved parties (patient, provider) or administrators.

parameters.name: appointmentId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the appointment.

patch.summary: Update an appointment's status or notes
patch.description: Partially updates an existing appointment's details, such as status or notes. Requires 'provider:write' or 'admin:manage' role. Patients might be able to cancel their own appointments.

parameters.name: appointmentId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the appointment to be updated.

requestBody.description: Partial appointment data to be updated.

post.description: Issues a new prescription for a patient. Requires 'provider:write' or 'admin:manage' role. All prescription details are sensitive PHI and are logged.

get.description: Retrieves details of a specific prescription by its unique ID. Access is restricted to the patient, prescribing provider, or administrators. All access is logged for HIPAA compliance.

parameters.name: prescriptionId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the prescription.

post.description: Creates a new medical record entry for a patient. This could be a lab result, progress note, or imaging report. Requires 'provider:write' or 'admin:manage' role. All medical records are sensitive PHI and are logged.

requestBody.description: Medical record details to be created.

value.content: Patient reports feeling better after antibiotics. No fever. Advised to complete full course of medication.

data.content: Patient reports feeling better after antibiotics. No fever. Advised to complete full course of medication.

RequestIdHeader.name: X-Request-ID
RequestIdHeader.description: Unique identifier for the request, used for tracing and debugging.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: A unique key to prevent duplicate requests. If a request with the same key is received within a certain timeframe, the server will return the same response without processing the request again. Recommended for all non-GET operations.

RateLimitLimit.description: The maximum number of requests that the client can make in the current rate limit window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: The number of requests remaining in the current rate limit window.

RateLimitReset.description: The time at which the current rate limit window resets, specified in UTC epoch seconds.

XRequestId.description: A unique identifier for the request, useful for tracing issues in logs.

StandardResponseEnvelope.description: Standard API response envelope for consistent output.

timestamp.description: The timestamp when the response was generated (ISO 8601 format).

statusCode.description: Overall status of the API operation.

message.description: A human-readable message providing more details about the response.

data.description: The actual response data, which varies based on the endpoint.

message.description: A human-readable message describing the error.
message.example: Invalid input provided for patient creation.

details.description: Optional array of specific validation errors or additional details.

field.description: The field that caused the error.

traceId.description: A unique identifier for the request, useful for tracing issues in logs.

totalCount.description: Total number of items available across all pages.

limit.description: The maximum number of items requested per page.

offset.description: The number of items skipped from the beginning of the list.

hasNextPage.description: Indicates if there are more pages available.

hasPreviousPage.description: Indicates if there is a previous page available.

Patient.description: Represents a patient in the healthcare system. Contains Protected Health Information (PHI).

dateOfBirth.description: Patient's date of birth (ISO 8601 date format).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the patient record was created (ISO 8601 format).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the patient record was last updated (ISO 8601 format).

CreatePatientRequest.description: Request body for creating a new patient.

dateOfBirth.description: Patient's date of birth (ISO 8601 date format).

UpdatePatientRequest.description: Request body for updating an existing patient. All fields are optional for partial updates.

dateOfBirth.description: Patient's date of birth (ISO 8601 date format).

name.description: Provider's full name (e.g., Dr. Emily White).

facilityId.description: Identifier of the facility where the provider practices.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the provider record was created (ISO 8601 format).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the provider record was last updated (ISO 8601 format).

Appointment.description: Represents a scheduled appointment between a patient and a provider.

patientId.description: Unique identifier of the patient attending the appointment.

providerId.description: Unique identifier of the provider conducting the appointment.

scheduledAt.description: The date and time the appointment is scheduled for (ISO 8601 format).

appointmentType.description: Type of appointment (e.g., Consultation, Follow-up, Check-up).

notes.description: Any additional notes or details about the appointment.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the appointment record was created (ISO 8601 format).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the appointment record was last updated (ISO 8601 format).

CreateAppointmentRequest.description: Request body for scheduling a new appointment.

patientId.description: Unique identifier of the patient for this appointment.

providerId.description: Unique identifier of the provider for this appointment.

scheduledAt.description: The date and time the appointment is scheduled for (ISO 8601 format).

appointmentType.description: Type of appointment (e.g., Consultation, Follow-up, Check-up).

notes.description: Any additional notes or details about the appointment.

UpdateAppointmentRequest.description: Request body for partially updating an appointment.

scheduledAt.description: The new date and time the appointment is scheduled for (ISO 8601 format).

notes.description: Updated notes or details about the appointment.
notes.example: Patient requested cancellation due to conflict.

Diagnosis.description: Represents a medical diagnosis for a patient.

patientId.description: Unique identifier of the patient who received the diagnosis.

providerId.description: Unique identifier of the provider who made the diagnosis.

diagnosedAt.description: Timestamp when the diagnosis was made (ISO 8601 format).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the diagnosis record was created (ISO 8601 format).

Prescription.description: Represents a medical prescription for a patient.

patientId.description: Unique identifier of the patient for whom the prescription is issued.

providerId.description: Unique identifier of the provider who issued the prescription.

frequency.description: Frequency of medication intake (e.g., 'Three times daily').

prescribedAt.description: Timestamp when the prescription was issued (ISO 8601 format).

refillsRemaining.description: Number of refills remaining for the prescription.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the prescription record was created (ISO 8601 format).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the prescription record was last updated (ISO 8601 format).

CreatePrescriptionRequest.description: Request body for creating a new prescription.

patientId.description: Unique identifier of the patient for whom the prescription is issued.

providerId.description: Unique identifier of the provider who issued the prescription.

frequency.description: Frequency of medication intake (e.g., 'Three times daily').

refillsRemaining.description: Number of refills remaining for the prescription.

MedicalRecord.description: Represents a medical record entry for a patient (e.g., lab result, progress note).

recordId.description: Unique identifier for the medical record.

patientId.description: Unique identifier of the patient associated with this record.

providerId.description: Unique identifier of the provider who created or updated this record.

content.description: The actual content of the medical record. This could be plain text, a JSON object, or a URL/reference to a document.
content.example: Blood test results: Hemoglobin 14.5 g/dL, White Blood Cell Count 7.2 K/uL.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the medical record was created (ISO 8601 format).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the medical record was last updated (ISO 8601 format).

CreateMedicalRecordRequest.description: Request body for creating a new medical record.

patientId.description: Unique identifier of the patient associated with this record.

providerId.description: Unique identifier of the provider creating this record.

content.description: The actual content of the medical record.
content.example: Patient reports feeling better after antibiotics. No fever. Advised to complete full course of medication.

Consent.description: Represents a patient's consent for data sharing.

consentId.description: Unique identifier for the consent record.

patientId.description: Unique identifier of the patient who granted consent.

dataSharingPurpose.description: Description of the purpose for which data sharing is consented (e.g., 'Research Study X', 'Sharing with primary care physician').

grantedAt.description: Timestamp when the consent was granted (ISO 8601 format).

expiresAt.description: Optional timestamp when the consent automatically expires (ISO 8601 format).

isRevoked.description: Indicates if the consent has been revoked.

revokedAt.description: Timestamp when the consent was revoked, if applicable (ISO 8601 format).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the consent record was created (ISO 8601 format).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the consent record was last updated (ISO 8601 format).

CreateConsentRequest.description: Request body for granting a new patient consent.

dataSharingPurpose.description: Description of the purpose for which data sharing is consented.

expiresAt.description: Optional timestamp when the consent automatically expires (ISO 8601 format).

BadRequest.description: Bad Request - The request was malformed or invalid.

details.issue: Date of birth must be in YYYY-MM-DD format.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized - Authentication is required or has failed.

error.message: Authentication token is missing or invalid.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden - The authenticated user does not have the necessary permissions.

error.message: User does not have permission to access this resource.

NotFound.description: Not Found - The requested resource could not be found.

InternalServerError.description: Internal Server Error - An unexpected error occurred on the server.

error.message: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.

OAuth2.description: OAuth 2.0 authentication with role-based access control. Supports patient, provider, and admin roles.

scopes.admin:manage: Full administrative access to all resources
